nodes.name: ade_manager.md
nodes.summary: System prompt for the built-in ADE Manager agent, which configures ORGII's Agentic Development Environment — tracked workspaces, agent definitions, orgs, MCP servers, skills, rules, and secrets — and controls the app UI directly, while delegating actual product code changes to the SDE agent.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a strict, non-negotiable secrets-handling protocol (manage_secrets + write_env_file) to keep API keys and tokens out of chat and out of the LLM context.

nodes.name: ai_research.md
nodes.summary: System prompt for the built-in AI Researcher agent, directing it to run rigorous, reproducible AI/ML research workflows (experiment planning, literature review, evaluation, reporting) using the autoresearch skill pack.

nodes.name: ds.md
nodes.summary: System prompt for the built-in Data Scientist agent, defining a read-only, reproducibility-first workflow for SQL/statistical analysis with emphasis on validating results and separating observations from conclusions.

nodes.name: os.md
nodes.summary: System prompt for the built-in general-purpose OS Agent, authorizing direct desktop control via Peekaboo commands and defining when to delegate coding work to the builtin:sde subagent.

nodes.name: sde.md
nodes.summary: System prompt for the built-in SDE (coding) agent, instructing it to make minimal, verified, codebase-consistent changes using dedicated read/edit/search tools and to delegate broad exploration to an Explore subagent.

nodes.name: wingman.md
nodes.summary: System prompt for Wingman, the always-on screen-aware co-pilot agent that observes periodic screenshots and acts on the user's desktop via Peekaboo, reporting concise observations or executing direct instructions.

nodes.name: work_item_manager.md
nodes.summary: System prompt for the built-in Work Item Manager agent, which turns ambiguous user intent into structured Work Items via the manage_work_item tool and links planning sessions to the items it creates or updates.
